notes: Speed Queen TC5 agitator top-load washer with a belt and a two-speed 1/2 HP motor. The parts manual also covers AWN632SP116CW01, AWN632SP116TW02 and two ZWN632SP116 models, and the output board control assembly changes at a serial number, so check the serial plate before ordering.

gaps: The two-speed 1/2 HP rating is from the spec sheet (TC5000WN column, page rendered); the parts list gives the motor kit's part number only.

Volts, amps, watts and a capacitor rating are left blank: the parts list gives part numbers only. Whether the motor is AC or DC, and whether capacitor 37377 is a run or start capacitor, are not given, so no ac flag is set.

Part 205217P is listed only as 'Pump'. It is claimed as listed with its place on the motor, belt and pump drawing, and not called a drain pump; a tub-to-pump hose (38351) is listed in the drain hose section.
Transmission 203768 is listed for 'lip seal models only'; the list does not say which of the five models are lip seal models.
There is no brake part type, so the brake kit is filed under gearbox by function.
The mixing valve is mapped to valve_solenoid by function; the list does not name its solenoids.
The output board control assembly changes at serial numbers 1912999999 and 2001000001 (parts 202508P and 204783).
method: Speed Queen spec sheet AR20-0032 (2020), hosted by AJ Madison and carrying Speed Queen's own branding; page rendered. Its Model No. row ties product code TC5000WN to AWN632SP116TW01, and the 'Two-Speed, 1/2 HP Motor' row is marked under TC5 only.
Alliance Laundry parts manual 204891R4, Home Topload Washers (March 2023): model list on printed p.3 includes AWN632SP116TW01.
Printed pages used (printed page = PDF page minus 2): control and touch switch p.5, lid switch p.7, fill hoses, mixing valve and pressure sensor p.11, motor, belt, pump and idler p.13, washtub p.15.
More printed pages: outer tub and springs p.17, drain hose p.19, weldment, brake and pulley p.21, transmission p.23, lead-in cord p.29, output board p.37.
Drawings are images; part numbers come from the lists beside them (the motor, belt and pump drawing, printed p.12, was rendered and looked at).

comps.spec: Motor kit, part 38034P (the list says it includes item 24, capacitor 37377). Speed Queen's spec sheet gives the TC5000WN a two-speed 1/2 HP motor.
Capacitor, part 37377, held by capacitor clamp 37535, in the motor, mounting bracket, belt, pump and idler section. Included in motor kit 38034P.
Agitate and spin belt, part 38174. Belt and pump kit RB150003 holds this belt and pump 205217P together.
Idler pulley, part 38225P, in idler lever kit 959P3, which includes the idler lever and idler shaft.
Pulley, part 204486, in the weldment and bearing assembly, brake and pulley section, with helix 38008.

Pump, part 205217P (the list's own name for it). It is drawn at the bottom of the motor, mounting bracket, belt, pump and idler drawing, below the motor and belt (item 18), and is sold with the belt as kit RB150003.

Transmission assembly, part 203768, which the list marks for lip seal models only and says includes sealant 200996P and a hub and lip seal kit. It is also supplied in outer tub and transmission kit 204568.
Brake kit, part 38505P. Brake pad kit 735P3 (three pads) and silicone grease 204253 for the pads are listed beside it.
Lower bearing, part 28944RP, listed in the weldment and bearing assembly, brake and pulley section beside weldment and bearing assembly 39253.
Output board control assembly, part 202508P through serial 1912999999, or part 204783 from serial 2001000001.
Control assembly, part 205214P, in the graphic panel, control support panel and controls section. Capacitive touch switch 204266 and LED display assembly 204488 are listed separately.
Lid switch assembly, part 204791, including jumper harness 204551 and switch 204523.
Pressure sensor, part 203843, listed with the fill hoses and mixing valve.
Mixing valve, part 203741, listed with the fill hoses and pressure sensor.
Fill hoses, 4 feet: part 203719 marked for hot water and part 203720 marked for cold water.
Drain hose, part 39893, and tub-to-pump hose, part 38351.
Stainless steel washtub kit, part 719P3. Washtub gasket 39122 is listed separately.
Leg spring, part 37575, in the outer tub section with leg plate 27926.
